text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — I pushed the weekly GPU capacity forecast. Need sign-off on APAC burst plan before Monday's promo event.
Tom Alvarez: On it. Is the APAC estimate including the extra 30% seq len we saw in last run?
Maya Chen: Yes — I baked in +30% token churn for the promo window (48h). That pushes ap-southeast1 peak to ~420 GPU-hours/day.
Li Wong: Reminder we only have 320 reserved GPUs in APAC cluster A, with 40 available for burst right now.
Sara Patel: If we provision preemptible skylake on top, how much cheaper vs on-demand?
Derek O'Neill: Preemptible saves ~55% @ batch throughput, but higher tail latency and eviction risk. For burst it's OK if we add fallback routing to us-west1.
Tom Alvarez: Routing note — cross-region fallbacks will add ~45–70ms p95 for chat flows. Is that acceptable for the promo SLAs?
Maya Chen: Marketing agreed to p95 up to 250ms for the weekend. So cross-region is within.
capacity-bot: [auto] Forecast snapshot generated 2026-03-17T10:12Z. Regions: us-west1 730 GPU-h/day, us-east1 610, eu-west1 480, ap-southeast1 420.
Li Wong: Flagging networking: we still have the intermittent BGP flap in ap-southeast1 from last week. Any mitigation?
Sara Patel: Ops scheduled maintenance on the transit gateway Sat 02:00–03:30 UTC, that might overlap. We should avoid heavy rollouts during that window.
Maya Chen: Good catch — I'll shift the burst spin-up earlier (Fri 22:00 UTC). Want to avoid the maintenance window.
Derek O'Neill: Also saw a handful of OOM pod evictions on nodepool-apac-2 yesterday — likely from longer sequences causing KV growth. Recommend we bump node memory for the pool or reduce per-node containers.
Tom Alvarez: Suggestion: enable prefix-KV caching for the promo load to reduce repeated prefix costs. That should lower GPU-hours by ~10–12%.
Maya Chen: Agreed — add caching + 10% quantization profile on non-sensitive models. I'll put together the exact config.
Sara Patel: Cost quick calc — with the above changes, ap-southeast1 peak reduces from 420 -> ~350 GPU-h/day. At $2.8/GPU-h that's ~$196/day savings vs full burst.
Li Wong: We need approvals for 40 additional burst GPUs from infra budget. Derek, can you ping finance for fast approval?
Derek O'Neill: Pinging finance now. @finance (cc: Maya) — quick approval requested for one-off capex to add 40 burst GPUs for 72 hours during promo.
Maya Chen: If finance is slow, fallback is spinning additional preemptibles across two zones to spread eviction risk.
capacity-bot: [auto] Action items created: #1234 allocate-burst-apac, #1235 enable-prefix-caching.
Tom Alvarez: Ops note — rolling drain plan for nodepool-apac-2: staggered 5-min drain per node to keep in-flight requests under threshold.
Sara Patel: I'll update the runbook and add the exact drain commands. Example: ``kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300``
Maya Chen: Final ask before I mark approved — any objections to starting burst spin-up Fri 22:00 UTC and enabling caching + quantize on non-sensitive models?
Li Wong: No objections from infra.
Tom Alvarez: No objections from runtime team.
Derek O'Neill: +1
Sara Patel: +1 — will own the runbook updates.
Maya Chen: Great — marking this as approved. Will post updates on status during spin-up. :rocket:
ops-bot: Scheduled job: spin-up 40 preemptible GPUs in ap-southeast1 starting 2026-03-20T22:00Z. Track progress in #ops-deployments.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — I'll close the loop after the Friday rehearsal.
